hooks.name: security-gate
hooks.description: Blocks force pushes to protected branches, destructive rm, and hardcoded secrets

hooks.name: audit-log
hooks.description: Appends file writes and notable Bash ops to .ai-memory/audit/ (local only, never committed)

hooks.name: pre-commit-gate
hooks.description: Scans staged files for debug artifacts (console.log, debugger, binding.pry, etc.) before git commit
